dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature fitting a smooth spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree angular steepness of the anterior margin contour relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum pixel base width is approximately 1.3 times the maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex arc fitted to the anterior-dorsal boundary of the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with a thickness approximately 0.7 times its length from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle (approximately 135 degrees) where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct light-toned lateral band or 'cape' extending from the cranial region along the upper flank below the dorsal fin.
